description: Local coding hints and a separate guide to programming principles.
untrusted: Analyzes source text locally without running student code.
codekompas.principles: Show programming principles in a separate tab.
codekompas.maxHints: Maximum number of hints shown at once per file.
codekompas.delay: Time to wait after typing, in milliseconds.
codekompas.maxCharacters: Skip larger files to keep the editor responsive.
codekompas.ignoreWords: Names you deliberately use and want CodeKompas to skip when checking spelling.
codekompas.disabledPrinciples: Programming principles to hide for now.
codekompas.maxPrinciples: Maximum number of concept cards shown at once in the Programming Principles tab.
codekompas.styleConventions: Show readability advice for capitalization in valid standard CSS property names.
codekompas.indentationHints: Show readability advice when code indentation mixes tabs and spaces.
